name: Wysa
one_liner: Wysa is an AI-powered mental health chatbot combining CBT, DBT, and mindfulness techniques with an option to add human coaching for affordable mental health support.
best_for: People wanting AI support with option for human coaching
Those who benefit from multiple therapeutic approaches (CBT, DBT, mindfulness)
People seeking affordable mental health support
Those who prefer a gentle, penguin-themed interface
People with anxiety, depression, or stress looking for 24/7 support
not_for: Those in crisis or needing immediate professional help
Those who strongly prefer human-only therapy
People who find AI chatbots frustrating
short_description: AI chatbot using CBT, DBT, and mindfulness with optional human coaching. Affordable 24/7 mental health support.
long_description: Wysa is an AI-powered mental health app featuring a friendly penguin chatbot that uses techniques from Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), mindfulness, and other evidence-based approaches. Unlike pure AI apps, Wysa offers optional human coaching sessions for additional support. The app has been used by millions and is backed by research showing effectiveness for depression and anxiety symptoms.
patient_summary: Wysa is a friendly AI penguin that helps you manage stress, anxiety, and low mood using therapy techniques. Chat anytime, and if you want, add sessions with a real human coach. It's affordable and available 24/7.

pricing.notes: Free AI chatbot. Premium adds more content. Human coaching packages available starting around $150 for multiple sessions.

privacy.notes: HIPAA compliant. Strong privacy practices. Has enterprise healthcare partnerships.

seo.title: Wysa: AI Therapy + Human Coaching | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Wysa combines AI chatbot therapy with optional human coaching. CBT, DBT, and mindfulness techniques. Free tier available. 4.8★, 100K reviews.

faqs.q: How is Wysa different from Woebot?
faqs.a: Both are AI mental health chatbots. Wysa offers optional human coaching and uses multiple approaches (CBT, DBT, mindfulness). Woebot focuses purely on CBT and is AI-only. Wysa has a friendly penguin character; Woebot has a robot character.

Wysa offers human 'coaches' not licensed therapists. Coaches can provide support and guidance but don't diagnose or treat mental health conditions. For clinical therapy, you'd need a different platform.
The AI chatbot features are free. Premium subscription ($12/month) adds more exercises and content. Human coaching costs extra, starting around $150 for session packages.
Yes. Wysa has been studied in multiple research studies showing effectiveness for reducing depression and anxiety symptoms. It's one of the more evidence-backed mental health AI apps available.

how_clinicians_use_it: Recommend for between-session support with AI and optional coaching
Provide patients access to CBT, DBT, and mindfulness exercises
Supplement treatment for patients who need more frequent check-ins
Use as step-down support as patients transition out of intensive treatment
clinician.implementation_notes: HIPAA-compliant version available for enterprise. Consumer version can be recommended directly. Enterprise version offers organization dashboards.
